notes.title: ver0.3.0 - Major Update
notes.notes:
Major Update
A brand new Combo System has been added in this update!

By landing multiple spells and skills, you can temporarily power up your character!
We’ve also added several new symbols and made some balance adjustments.

Enjoy the new content!



 
AdditionsNew Feature
Combo

Each time a spell or skill hits, your combo count increases.

Some spells add 1 combo only upon activation.

AoE (area-of-effect) attacks add only 1 combo in total.

Every 10 combos increases your damage on the current floor by +5%.

Combo count resets when you move to the next floor.

 


Symbols
Items (2 types):

COMBO CORN

GAMING COIN

Spells (6 new Warrior-only spells):

SMALL CROSS CUT

MINI BODY PRESS

OLD OLD RICE

ONI SLASH

DESTRUCTION STRIKE

CALORIE IMPACT

Relics (2 types):

COMBO SWORD

COMBO SHIELD

 


Balance AdjustmentsDamage Calculation
Spell damage used to ignore 100% of enemy ARMOR.

→ Now adjusted to ignore 75%.

notes.title: ver0.2.21 - Update
notes.notes:
Balance Adjustments

Decreased the Warrior's initial stats.
Added "POISON 2" effect to the abilities of the enemies CRAB and SCORPION.


Improvements

Changed the following keyboard key bindings:
　- [Toggle Details]: H → F
　- [Inventory]: I → E
　- [Investigation Mode Toggle]: G → R
Adjusted various UI elements.


Bug Fixes

Adjusted the game to force quit when loading save data with errors after selecting "Continue".
　- We have confirmed that selecting "Continue" after the forced shutdown allows the game to resume normally.
　- This is a temporary measure to prevent progression with faulty data.
　- Please wait a little longer for a fundamental fix.

notes.title: ver0.2.0 - Major Update
notes.notes:
Major Update  
Adventurers, thank you for your patience!  

The long-awaited second character, "Mage", has finally arrived!  
Additionally, over "50 new symbols", including enemies, and more than "40 new relics" have been added!  

With extensive balance adjustments, "Slot & Dungeons" has evolved significantly—enjoy the enhanced gameplay!  

Additions  
Character  
  
 Mage  
  

Stages  
  
 Volcano  
  - Difficulty Levels: 1–3  
  

Symbols  
  
 Items: 5 types  
 Spells: 37 types  
 Enemies: 16 types  
 Relics: 44 types  
 

Balance Adjustments
  
 Some symbols have been made exclusive to "Warrior" or "Mage"
 Adjustments to various "symbols & relics"
  - Usage limits  
  - Effect details  
  - Effect values  
  - Rarity  
 Changed the "Warrior's starting relic"
  

Others
  
 "Performance optimizations"
 "Minor improvements and fixes"

notes.title: 'Ranking Reset' and 'Data Deletion' in the Next Update
notes.notes:
Hello, players!
This is an announcement from the "Slot & Dungeons" development team.

As part of the upcoming major update "ver0.1.0," we plan to delete the current "ranking data". This update includes significant balance adjustments, and we hope you will enjoy the ranking feature in the new environment.

Additionally, after applying this update, any remaining interrupted data will be deleted when you launch "Slot & Dungeons." We kindly ask for your understanding in advance.

"ver0.1.0" will include many new symbols, adjustments, and the arrival of new enemies, making "Slot & Dungeons" even more fun and exciting! We hope you look forward to it!

The "Slot & Dungeons" Development Team

notes.title: The free demo version of Slot & Dungeons is now available!
notes.notes:
Adventurers, thank you for your patience!
The demo version of Slot & Dungeons is finally here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181397/2339bc4edf4858a3591d7b7c1981b057bc3ad2d5.jpg

Head over to the store page now and enjoy the game to your heart’s content!

Slot & Dungeons is a solo deck-building rogue-lite where the placement of enemies and items within each floor changes based on the slots. To help you get the most out of the demo version, we’ve prepared a few Q&As:


Q: How can I share my thoughts or report any bugs?
A: Please join the official Slot & Dungeons Discord server, which has been set up alongside the demo release! While we welcome reviews on Steam, we plan to use Discord as the main platform for communication going forward.

Q: Can I transfer my progress to the full version?
A: Unfortunately, we do not plan to support data transfer at this time. Please enjoy the demo version with the understanding that major adjustments will be made for the full release.

Q: Will the demo version be updated?
A: Absolutely! We plan to add new features that didn’t make it into the initial release, as well as make regular updates for bug fixes and improvements. Announcements for updates will be posted on Steam and Discord.

Q: How long will the demo version be available?
A: For now, the demo will be available at least until the full version is released.


We’d be thrilled to hear your feedback about the game—your thoughts are a huge source of motivation for the development team!
We hope you enjoy the Slot & Dungeons demo version!
